content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question—how can I access three [product_name] devices over the internet? Currently, I can reach one of them using port 80, since I have port forwarding set up on my network router. Is there a way to change the device port from 80 to, for example, 81? I can't find this option in the settings. Best regards, [user_name]
Using port forwarding on your router exposes your system to increased risk of hacking. Setting up a VPN is a safer alternative.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking to remotely access multiple [product_name] devices via the internet, but is unable to change the default HTTP port in the device’s settings. This limitation affects the ability to set up flexible and secure remote access to several devices and highlights a lack of clear instructions on secure connection methods.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to modify the HTTP port for each [product_name] device, allowing for secure and individualized remote access through port forwarding.
